youtube_description:
Parts needed:-
KF200 (plug n play programmer)
KF204 (holden commodore key remote along with module)

This is how I programmed new set of keys for my Holden commodore 2000 VT. Had to get a new key with chip and blade in it. I used existing blade from my other key as it was working fine.
youtube_title: HOW TO PROGRAM HOLDEN COMMODORE NEW IGNITION KEY VT VX VZ VE
